model: kling3_0 pro, 16:9, 8 s, sound off, medias = [start_image X, end_image X] (start = end = the plate); API echo cfg_scale 0.5, enhance_prompt false; declined_preset_id 24bae836 on every batch item
prompt: Animate the supplied image with extremely restrained, continuous ambient motion while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. The campfire's flames sway and a thin smoke column rises and drifts; a few embers float upward and fade; the lit wall tent's glow breathes slowly (no more than 15%); the lake surface glints. The three horses stand still apart from one slow tail swish; the wagon, tents, pot and tripod stay still; no figures. One uninterrupted shot. Every moving element completes exactly one slow, even cycle and eases back to its original shape, so the first and last frames are identical. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, sparkles toward the camera, whole-frame flicker or exposure change; nothing flickers faster than twice a second. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.
reason: Motion not delivered: the loop is a near-still. The campfire flames, the smoke column, the embers and the lake are frozen; nothing the MOTION sentence asks for is visible. Measured on the lossless seam: optical-flow displacement vs frame 0, max over the loop, fire core p99.9 0.24 px, smoke 0.27 px, lake 0.63 px, horses 0.30 px (whole frame p99.9 1.8 px, 0% of pixels > 4 px); fire-core mean |dY| max 2.3/255; fire-light zone ptp 0.5-0.9%. The flame shapes at frames 0/24/48/.../168 (220% crops) are the same. For comparison the accepted campfire loop (MV-11L) has fire p99.9 18.9 px and 0.8% of pixels > 4 px. Shipping it would cost 1.25 MB (MP4) / 0.50 MB (WebM) and a decode for a picture that looks like the poster.
hardLimits: all pass: no people/figures/faces/hands (tent interior, wagon, fire, horses checked at 200-250% on 0/25/50/75/100%); no text/logos; 3 horses, 4 legs + 1 head each, consistent with the plate on every sampled frame (heads/legs tracked <= 0.16 px); 0 flashes/s (whole + tiles), red share 2.8e-4; fire/tent/lantern light ptp <= 1%, 0 reversals/s; 0 audio streams

encodedForTheCheck.tool: seam --k=12 --tier=S --method=residual --crf-mp4=23 --crf-webm=28 (scratch only, not staged; poster would be 113732 bytes at q50, over 100 KiB)

retake.model: kling3_0 pro 16:9 8 s, sound off, start_image = end_image = iconic-camp job 3c420eac (14 credits); decline the preset intercept as in B1
retake.why: B1's PREFIX ('extremely restrained') plus a long STILL list plus 'every moving element completes exactly one slow, even cycle' let Kling satisfy the pin by freezing the fire. The MV-11L wording that produced a visibly moving fire named the fire as the only moving element and asked for continuous motion.
retake.prompt: Animate the supplied image with gentle but clearly visible, continuous motion in the campfire, while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. The campfire's flames dance and sway continuously for the whole clip, licking up around the base of the hanging pot; a thin wisp of pale smoke rises steadily from the fire and drifts slowly to the right; a few small embers float upward and fade. The firelight on the ground and on the lit wall tent varies by no more than about fifteen percent and never flickers faster than twice a second. The three horses at the rail, the tents, the covered wagon, the pot, the tripod, the lake and the sky stay still; each horse keeps four legs and one head. One uninterrupted shot; the flames and the smoke keep moving all the way through, and the first and last frames match the supplied image. No cuts, flashes, bursts, sparks toward the camera, whole-frame flicker or exposure change. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.
retake.accept: fire core flow p99.9 >= ~4 px (MV-11L 18.9 px) with the fire-lit ground glow <= 15% and <= 4 reversals/s; horses 4 legs / 1 head at 200% on 0/25/50/75/100%; seam residual K=12 if the raw join >= 0.98, else blend K=12 --rotate=auto --plate; never boomerang (smoke).
